Chapter 727: Chapter 22 Crushing Tier 11 (Please Subscribe)

“The master has left?”

Zha Ran Gu looked up and discovered that the figure sitting in meditation not far away had disappeared.

“It seems that the master doesn’t care much about this matter.”

Zha Ran Gu thought to himself, while simultaneously a hint of concern arose in his heart.

Xueyu Tavern had passed on the information as soon as possible to him, which surely meant they had sensed something different.

But Lin Yuan didn’t even ask several detailed questions about it, which in Zha Ran Gu’s view, was perhaps a bit too complacent?

...

Zha Ran Gu had no idea that Lin Yuan had already thoroughly understood the whole story through the information-sharing channels established by the external human civilization.

He even knew who was behind it all.

…

In the northwestern region of Xueyu Ancient Country.

It was a wasteland as far as the eye could see, filled with desolate Gobi everywhere.

On a sand dune, Lin Yuan stood quietly, his gaze fixed on a certain spot a hundred miles away.

Compared to the native Witch Ancestors, the powerhouses from the Myriad Tribes not only possessed even more formidable combat power and near-perfect application of power, but they also had one more advantage.

That was perception.

When the Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses fell into the Two-dimensional World, although all means were suppressed and they had to start over according to the rules of the two-dimensional world, the spirit will power originating from their true body still brought with it powerful perception.

When Lin Yuan was at the peak of the Witch Emperor, he accepted the bounty of the Yun Mountain Eighteen Thieves, and with his “perception,” it only took him less than half a day in a vast primitive forest to lock onto the location of the Yun Mountain Eighteen Thieves.

For the native powerhouses, this was something inconceivable.

Even the formidable Witch Ancestor would find it difficult to locate the Yun Mountain Eighteen Thieves in such a short time.

Of course, the perception of the Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses depended on the strength they possessed in that world.

Now, as a Witch Ancestor of the Eighteenth Realm, Lin Yuan’s perception enveloped everything within a hundred miles.

At the edge of the hundred miles, Lin Yuan detected several massive auras lurking, at least all existing in the Witch Ancestor’s Tenth Realm, a domain that native powerhouses could never reach in their entire lives.

“One, two, three, four, five, six… a total of six. According to the intelligence, the Tuoba Ancient God formed a group with five Tier 11 special lives to hunt and search for ‘rare items’…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, naturally, he had collected all the information about the Tuoba Ancient God and his group before making a move.

In this small group, Tuoba Ancient God and another special life named ‘Pei Shen’ were the strongest.

They were probably at the level of the Twelfth Realm of the Witch Ancestor, while the other four were between the Tenth and Eleventh Realm of the Witch Ancestor.

And Tuoba Ancient God possessed a defensive ‘rare item,’ while that Pei Shen had an offensive ‘rare item.’

The latter was a pitch-black iron rod which, in terms of pure killing power, was not as strong as the blood-colored long knife of the ‘Hou Zhu’ from the Prison Tribe, but it was still considerable.

“Just to be safe, let’s take a look first.”

A thought crossed Lin Yuan’s mind, and he produced a bronze compass.

Although from the intelligence, the group led by Tuoba Ancient God would not be a match for him.

What can a Witch Ancestor of the Twelfth Realm do against a Witch Ancestor of the Eighteenth Realm?

Even with ‘rare items’? That, too, depends on the strength of the user.

But Lin Yuan still decided to use the bronze compass to play it safe.

It’s always right to be cautious in everything.

The use of the bronze compass was to premonition the danger that was about to come and to point out a path of survival for the user.

This ability, which appeared to be ‘passive,’ had been discovered by Lin Yuan after research to also have a ‘proactive’ effect.

For instance, at this moment, Lin Yuan was using the bronze compass,

As long as the results showed that all was safe, it meant that the group led by Tuoba Ancient God wouldn’t pose any threat to him.

Whirrr.

The copper needle suspended in the center of the compass quickly came to a stop.

At the same time, a piece of information surged into Lin Yuan’s mind.

“No danger has been detected at present.”

After glancing at the copper needle, Lin Yuan put away the compass.

…

In a devastated Gobi.

Six figures were either standing or sitting, their postures casual.

As Tier 11 special lives, they were powerful ancient gods from the deep Cosmic Starry Skies.

Even after falling into this Two-dimensional World and lying dormant for the first few years, they quickly rose to prominence.

At the beginning of their descent, those Ninth and Tenth Rank powerhouses from the Myriad Tribes might have had a chance to encircle and kill an Eleventh Rank powerhouse with sheer numbers.

But now?

After more than a hundred years of adaptation, the Eleventh Rank powerhouses had long since created a massive gap between themselves and the Ninth and Tenth Rank powerhouses from the Myriad Tribes.

Over a hundred years, those Ninth and Tenth Rank powerhouses might just be entering the Witch Ancestor Realm, but the Eleventh Rank had at least cultivated to the Seventh or Eighth Realm of Witch Ancestor.

“In this search of Xueyu Ancient Country, for over half a year, we have eliminated more than a dozen powerhouses from the Myriad Tribes and have also obtained a ‘rare item’.” One of the special lives spoke, the tone quite pleased.

In the Main Universe, the value of a ‘rare item’ could provoke a Supreme Being to act, like the Cosmic Aurora for instance.

But in this Two-dimensional World, they, as Tier 11 lives, also had the chance to acquire it?

“It’s just that we don’t know what use this rare item has.” Pei Shen, holding the pitch-black iron rod, shook his head slightly, “That Ice Clan life would rather blow itself up than honestly disclose it.”

The Ice Clan is a powerful clan belonging to the Peak Clans and the Yu Clan Grand Alliance, and that Ice Clan life only had Tenth Rank strength in the outside world.

But his luck was extremely good, having fortuitously obtained a ‘rare item.’

Originally, this Ice Clan life intended to hide in Xueyu Ancient Country and slowly study the capabilities of the ‘rare item.’

However, he hadn’t expected to be discovered by the group of special lives led by Tuoba Ancient God, and upon being killed, it was revealed that he carried a ‘rare item.’

With the power of Tuoba Ancient God, a Witch Ancestor of the Twelfth Realm, his perception covered a range of fifty miles, the Ice Clan life only realized that he had been targeted when Tuoba Ancient God approached within ten miles range.
